DERIVATION: the .do imports 3508_num.csv (header cells 'NAME: label'), renames each variable to the text before ':', lowercases, and Bookmark 8 sets item = the literal lowercased CIS names p19, p22a -- core model s3 pattern 1, Step 5b exempt, no verification_/verify_ files written. LABELS: ES3508 VARIABLE LABELS P19 'Grado en el que le gustaría a la persona entrevistada tener una relación amorosa o sentimental', P22A 'Grado en que le gustaría estar enamorada a la persona entrevistada' -- terse summaries that pin each code to its question 2/2; cues3508.pdf independently prints each question with its own tag [P19] / [P22A]. VALUE LABELS (identical for both): 1 'Mucho' 2 'Bastante' 3 '(NO LEER) Regular' 4 'Poco' 5 'Nada' 8 'N.S.' 9 'N.C.' 0 'N.P.' = the printed options (minus N.P.). All asserted in .cache/spain_2026_love_desire/build.R as exact substrings: 'P.19 <question> Filtros: Si P17=(1) ir a la siguiente. [P19] (CATEGORÍA NOMINAL) Mucho' and the P.22a equivalent with 'Si P22=(1)', in the whitespace-normalised pdftotext -raw text, plus both variable labels and both value-label lines in ES3508. FILTERS (printed in the questionnaire, confirmed in the data): P.19 is skipped when P17=1 ('¿En la actualidad tiene Ud. una relación amorosa o sentimental?' = Sí), so it was asked only of the 1,278 without a current relationship (P19=0 N.P. iff P17=1, 3,729/3,729, 0 off-diagonal); P.22a is skipped when P22=1 ('¿Está Ud. actualmente enamorado/a?' = Sí), so it was asked only of the 1,381 not currently in love (P22A=0 iff P22=1, 3,626/3,626). REBUILD, decisive: reading 3508_num.csv (5,007 records; id = row number), setting 0/8/9 to missing and then 3 to missing as the .do does, cov_sex = SEXO (Hombre/Mujer in live), cov_age = EDAD reproduces the live table exactly: 2,598 rows both, 1,508 ids both, 0 only-rebuilt / 0 only-live, 0 resp / cov_sex / cov_age mismatches, 0 duplicate id-item keys (.cache/spain_2026_love_desire/rebuild.R, rebuild.log; live via irw_fetch served from the local irw cache written by table_context.R). ANTI-SWAP: relabelling p19<->p22a gives 418 only-alt / 418 only-live keys, so the codes are not interchangeable. Live item x resp (1/2/4/5): p19 204/334/359/359 (mean 3.30); p22a 233/387/380/342 (mean 3.20); both use all four live levels and each has an option row. resp 1 = Mucho, higher resp = LESS desire. DROPPED TO MISSING by the .do (a caveat, not an error): 0 N.P. (filtered out) p19 3,729 / p22a 3,626; code 3 '(NO LEER) Regular' -- a volunteered, not-read-out midpoint -- p19 13 / p22a 18 (31), so live resp is 1,2,4,5 with no 3; 8 N.S./9 N.C. p19 6/3, p22a 10/11 (30). 1,278-13-9 = 1,256 and 1,381-18-21 = 1,342 live rows. No option rows for 0/3/8/9 since they are not in the live resp set. TEXT (text_source=study_materials): item_text = each printed question verbatim from cues3508.pdf (line wrap joined, 'P.19 ' / 'P.22a ' numbering stripped); the read-out response options ', mucho, bastante, poco o nada?' are part of each printed question and kept. Two separate questions with no shared lead-in, so instructions and section_prompt are blank, one trivial section (the spain_2026_love_conceptions shape). The filter lines are routing, not read to respondents, and are not shipped as text; they are disclosed in public_note. option_text = the four printed anchors = value labels 1,2,4,5. translation_source=machine_translation: CIS publishes Estudio 3508 in Spanish only; the _translated columns were written by IRW, anchors following spain_2026_love_association ('A lot', 'Quite a lot', 'A little', 'Not at all'); 'enamorado/a' rendered 'in love' (the /a gender slash has no English counterpart). STEP 3b: dictionary Description 'Desire to have a relationship and to be in love' matches P.19 and P.22a; the .do comment names P19, P22A and live has exactly those two codes. No instrument mismatch. DICTIONARY DEFECT (already logged by the orchestrator): Reference reads 'Percepción de la prostitución, Estudio 3508' but Estudio 3508 is 'Percepción social del amor'. RIGHTS: no block; applied the existing instrument_rights_register.csv CIS row (line 117, verdict allow, every CIS survey year). No register row written. SIBLINGS (spain_2026_love_gestures, _importance, same round) not touched; all scratch under .cache/spain_2026_love_desire/.
public_note: The English in the _translated columns was machine-translated by IRW from the Spanish CIS administered (CIS publishes this questionnaire in Spanish only); the two items were asked of different subsets -- p19 only of respondents with no current romantic relationship (1,278) and p22a only of respondents not currently in love (1,381) -- so the table covers 1,508 of the survey's 5,007 respondents; resp 1 is 'a lot' and 5 'not at all', so higher values mean less desire; and the IRW processing script drops the volunteered, not-read-out middle answer 'Regular' (3; 31 responses) as well as 'don't know'/'no answer' (30) to missing, so resp takes only the values 1, 2, 4 and 5.
